chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr, from some of our companions: he asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about mut'ah—when does it take place? He said:
He may perform mut'ah as long as he thinks that he will catch up with the people at Mina.

key_terms.الْمُتْعَةِ: tamattu' in the context of hajj rites
key_terms.مَتَى: the time at which an act is valid
key_terms.يُدْرِكُ: he reaches or catches up with

ai.seo_question: Until what point can a person perform mut'ah before joining the people at Mina?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the time limit for performing mut'ah in the rites of hajj. It states that one may remain in the state permitting mut'ah so long as he believes he will still reach the people at Mina in time.
